interpretation: The 144 seed-question outcomes are paired repetitions of 48 questions, not 144 independent questions; the CI resamples whole families across three fixed seeds.
limits: The whole multi-run scientific harness peaks above the native 768 MiB per-job work reservation. No OS hard RSS limit was installed for that harness; only the separate isolated maximum-shape product-job screen demonstrates a peak below the reservation.
48 questions in 24 whole construction families are repeated for three fixed lower initializations. 144 outcomes are not 144 independent mathematical questions.
The family bootstrap averages over these three fixed seeds and resamples the 24 declared families. It is not a confidence interval over arbitrary initialization seeds.
The source grammar has four bounded operation recipes and shared declared helper prerequisites. Added construction steps do not guarantee greater mathematical difficulty in every recipe.
The upper model learns values for bounded compositions of implemented data, objective and step-size choices. It does not invent arbitrary algorithms, modify the calculus or authorize proofs.
The 48 outer trials have additional full-system cost. Reporting equal final arm ceilings as equal lifetime compute would be incorrect.

Direct meta comparisons test the complete trained controller against the specified fixed and random controls. They do not separately isolate upper training from an identically structured untrained upper controller.
The secondary 128-expansion condition also adds exploration, so it is not a monotonic budget-only comparison.
Ordinary autonomous questions use the maintained bounded grammar and checked graph proposals. This trial does not qualify semantic interest assessment or unrestricted mathematical discovery.
Development promotion, local restart/gossip integration, held-out quality, hosted CI and physical deployment are separate evidence layers.

Outer novel acquisition families are partitioned from final novel acquisition families; the meta outcomes use the shared development gate. The independent final families are never meta-training labels.
Technical operation, held-out learning quality, hosted CI, release-candidate packaging and physical deployment are separate evidence layers.
The final receipt commit requires its own exact-head hosted checks; this receipt records the immutable scientific source checks without a circular final commit hash.
Complete Full Cargo matrix and physical multiple-host or production deployment are not qualified.

unseeded-meta-loop.claim: One ordinary initially empty local node, no formal_goal or injected proof/checkpoint: built-in question-only grammar and checked graph proposals produce own proofs, 250 real candidate updates and complete native qualification. The actual trial updates the neural meta model and paired Adam; restart recovers their exact state and the next executed training plan uses those learned weights and model-bound development feedback. This qualifies integration, not a learned solve-rate gain or unrestricted mathematical discovery.

physical_costs.interpretation: Shared acquisition is physically counted once in whole-process totals and charged to each adaptive ceiling. The learned system additionally pays all outer training; final lower ceilings are matched, lifetime compute is not.
